copy.curiosityHook: Camp Crystal Lake's tragic history was supposed to be in the past, so what unseen force is waiting in the surrounding trees to prove the nightmare never truly ended?
copy.description: Five years after a brutal bloodbath devastated Camp Crystal Lake, a new group of counselors arrives nearby, oblivious to the menacing presence stalking the woods and ready to revive a grisly local legend.
copy.vibeSummary: Grim and suspenseful, this steady-paced slasher combines heavy dread with an engaged, communal thrill ideal for group viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by Steve Miner, this lean horror sequel delivers tight 86-minute slasher tension, turning wooded shadows and mounting dread into an engaging watch for a night with friends.

allowedMaterial: Camp Crystal Lake setting five years after the original bloodbath
Arrival of new camp counselors oblivious to the danger
An ominous lurking presence stalking the woods
excludedMaterial: Identity of the killer or relationship to previous events
Specific counselor deaths and victim order
